task_title: Classify Go module-local imports and hard impact errors
task_criteria: PROOF: The committed DF-WARPFS-173 regression test passes for a single-word Go module and confirms util/util.go impact lists app/main.go; PROOF: initialized cold graph impact either succeeds via auto-parse or exits nonzero without reporting success for a hard graph error; PROOF: consensus-style URL-shaped module resolution remains covered by existing graph behavior; FAILIF: the module-local import is emitted as a std pseudo-node, the focused regression test fails, or a hard impact error exits zero.

items.criterion: PROOF: The committed DF-WARPFS-173 regression test passes for a single-word Go module and confirms util/util.go impact lists app/main.go; PROOF: initialized cold graph impact either succeeds via auto-parse or exits nonzero without reporting success for a hard graph error; PROOF: consensus-style URL-shaped module resolution remains covered by existing graph behavior; FAILIF: the module-local import is emitted as a std pseudo-node, the focused regression test fails, or a hard impact error exits zero.
items.detail: All four proof points verified with actual command output. (1) Focused regression test: `cargo test -p hilo-cli --test dfwarpfs173_go` => "test result: ok. 2 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored" — `single_word_go_module_import_is_a_pkg_dependency ... ok` and `initialized_cold_graph_impact_never_reports_success_for_missing_warm ... ok`. The test (hilo-cli/tests/dfwarpfs173_go.rs:44-83) builds a `module probea` tree, warms, runs `graph impact util/util.go`, asserts stdout contains `app/main.go` and does NOT contain `std:probea/util`. (2) Cold graph: manual run in a fresh `hilo init`-ed repo => `error: No complete graph warm found. Run `hilo graph warm` first (project root: /tmp/df173-cold-MYp3).` with `COLD_IMPACT_RC=1` — nonzero, no false success. Gate is hilo-cli/src/commands/graph.rs:2064-2067 (`anyhow::bail!` when a project manifest exists but no freshness state). (3) URL-shaped module: manual consensus-style run (`module github.com/totalwindupflightsystems/consensus`) => edges.jsonl `{"from":"cmd/main.go","to":"pkg:github.com/totalwindupflightsystems/consensus/internal/harness","rel":"imports",...}` and `graph impact internal/harness/planning.go` lists `cmd/main.go` rc=0. Existing coverage retained: `cargo test -p hilo_graph --lib` => "test result: ok. 585 passed; 0 failed" including `resolution::tests::resolves_nested_go_file_to_module_package` (example.com/demo), `resolves_go_file_in_module_root`, `go_and_rust_resolution_coexist_in_one_tree`, `java_resolution_coexists_with_other_languages`, and the new `go_module_path_reads_single_word_module`. (4) No std pseudo-node: manual single-word run produced edges.jsonl `{"from":"app/main.go","to":"pkg:probea/util",...}` and `grep -c "std:probea"` = 0; hilo-graph/src/parser.rs:2323 asserts `!targets.contains(&"std:probea/util")`. The classifier fix is at hilo-graph/src/parser.rs:499-505 (`classify_go` checks module prefix before the dot heuristic) and is wired from the single Go import entrypoint at hilo-graph/src/parser.rs:329-337. The hard-error change at hilo-graph/src/impact.rs:686 and :917 replaces `.ok()` with `?`, propagating `GraphResult` instead of silently degrading. `cargo clippy -p hilo_graph -p hilo-cli --all-targets -- -D warnings` => "Finished `dev` profile" with 0 warnings/errors; LSP diagnostics empty. [resolution 0.03; util/util.go, app/main.go]
